scope.research_question: Whether official/public sources can support a predeclared, point-in-time, total-return-aware direct A-share quality/value screen and individual-person action feasibility.
scope.long_run_hurdle_boundary: A 5% long-run annualized figure is a research hurdle only. It is neither a guarantee, a forecast, nor a result of this memo.

evidence_boundary.method: The ledger re-verifies existing case-scoped, hashed official raw samples and route pages. It does not upgrade their scope, obtain entitlement, or treat sample retrieval as point-in-time delivery.
evidence_boundary.sample_limit: A positive response for one code, page, or window is field-discovery evidence only, not coverage, revision, availability, entitlement, or execution proof.
evidence_boundary.rights_limit: Public website access and a website legal statement are not a written license for retained raw/normalized data, historical replay, derivatives, or independent audit.

official_routes: SSE current A-share list and status query
required_data_blocks.gap: No accepted Shanghai-Shenzhen-Beijing point-in-time daily universe including terminated securities, status history, reconciliations, or revisions.

required_data_blocks.purpose: Measure returns and model a feasible, conservative trade state.
official_routes: SSE day-k and historical market-data product route
SZSE/BSE quotation and market-data authorization routes
required_data_blocks.gap: A five-row sample for one SSE stock does not provide all venues, adjustment basis, total return, executable capacity, no-fills, or source-time/revision lineage.

required_data_blocks.purpose: Construct quality and value inputs without using later revisions at an earlier decision date.
official_routes: SSE regular-report and company-announcement index plus PDF
Shenzhen Securities Information data-service inquiry route
required_data_blocks.gap: The retained index supplies metadata and PDF paths, not normalized statements, available_at proof, version/revision lineage, or all-market coverage.

required_data_blocks.purpose: Create total return and per-share / value measures.
official_routes: SSE dividend and bonus/capitalization query routes
CNINFO historical dividend, capital, restricted-share, issuance, and termination disclosure routes
required_data_blocks.gap: The dividend and bonus samples are partial. They do not constitute a complete, versioned, tax/payment-aware corporate-action ledger reconciled to prices.

required_data_blocks.purpose: Keep an observed signal separate from an executable result.
official_routes: SSE/SZSE/BSE rulebooks and historical effective versions
required_data_blocks.gap: Exchange and regulator rules do not prove a particular individual's permissions, fee terms, route support, usable balance, fills, or settlement outcome.

source_ledger.does_not_support: Historical all-venue daily universe, delisted coverage, point-in-time availability, or eligibility.
Total return, corporate actions, all-market coverage, tradeability, capacity, or execution.
Normalized financial statements, available_at validation, field-level PIT version chain, or a full universe.
Complete event taxonomy, payment confirmation, taxation applicability, revisions, price reconciliation, or total return.
Full daily tradeability, price-limit state, account eligibility, or fill confirmation.

observed_facts: SSE historical data route covers Shanghai A-shares, B-shares and indices.
The page describes historical Level-1, Level-2 snapshot/tick/order-book and end-of-day categories.
The page describes yearly subscription and CSV format.
source_ledger.does_not_support: Case entitlement, actual delivery, cross-venue coverage, PIT financials/events, or executable strategy evidence.

source_ledger.authority: Shanghai Stock Exchange / Shenzhen Stock Exchange
observed_facts: Both pages state exchange ownership / intellectual-property boundaries for website information.
Both pages describe non-commercial browsing/download conditions and limitations on specified uses without written permission.
source_ledger.does_not_support: A written data license for retained raw/normalized data, replay, derived analysis, or independent audit.

conditions: Freeze the universe, factor definitions, accounting normalization, exclusions, rebalance frequency, event treatment, cost model, failure states, and stop conditions before T0.
Capture raw official universe/status snapshots and disclosure documents from T0 onward with retrieve time, source publication time when supplied, hash, version, and reviewer record.
Do not calculate returns until a complete, payment-aware corporate-action ledger is reconciled to price data; unresolved events must stop the affected calculation.
Record no-fill/unknown rather than forcing theoretical executions when tradeability, account permission, price limits, or cost data are missing.
Obtain account-specific broker confirmation before any real-world action.
prohibitions: No historical backfill of inputs not retained at the decision time.
No parameter changes based on observed results.
No upgrading an observed candidate to an investment recommendation without complete company research, valuation, risk, and execution review.
No claim that a forward observation validates or guarantees a 5% annualized result.

company_research_route_after_universe_ga.entry_condition: A frozen and evidenced universe gate produces a research candidate; this is not an investment action.
required_modules: Official disclosure and version pack: annual/interim/quarterly reports, audit opinion, corrections/restatements, exchange inquiries/replies, capital changes, and major events.
Financial-quality card: reported earnings, cash flow, balance sheet, working capital, debt, accruals, capex, shares, and dilution tied to source pages/hashes.

Business/governance card: segments, customer/supplier concentration only where disclosed, capacity/orders only where disclosed, related parties, pledges, control, audit qualifications, litigation, and regulatory events.
Market/execution card: status, liquidity, price limits, halts, corporate actions, and account eligibility recorded separately from quality/value characteristics.
Valuation, contrarian, risk, catalyst, invalidation, and monitoring review only after the preceding evidence is complete.
company_research_route_after_universe_ga.downgrade_rule: Any missing material financial, share-count, action, current-price, execution, or source-version evidence leaves the name watchlist-only / insufficient evidence.

next_allowed_work: Draft a separate forward-observation protocol before collecting any new H1 input or ranking any security.
Or obtain and independently accept an entitled PIT data package with universe, financial, corporate-action, market-state, execution, rights, and revision documentation.
Do not select securities, run a retrospective result, construct a portfolio, or issue an action until the applicable gates are passed.
